title: Crockpot Short Ribs - 5 Ingredients!
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 2.3333x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.

ingredients.notes: Main protein anchored by source WEIGHT, exact 2.3333x = 7 lb = 3175 g. item_id NULL with reason: price-ingredient answers ABSENT - no commodity claims the term, no board cell, no capture match. ABSENT is not not-carried: every Omaha meat case sells short ribs at least seasonally, so the term is ENQUEUED blocking and carriage is the pricer's ruling; null = pantry-static pricing meanwhile. Deliberately NOT stretched onto beef-chuck-roast: same primal but a different cut at a different price class (leg-quarters-are-not-thighs precedent). NEW commodity proposed to the registrar (see new_commodity_proposals). NEW food-DB row added (USDA FDC 170827, chuck short ribs boneless lean and fat choice raw, 240 cal/100 g) - the row's macros reproduce the source's published 581 cal / 39 g protein within -0.5% / +3.3%, confirming cut and portion.

Fresh garlic to the garlic commodity (bulbs; the map's each = 42.6 g bulb). densities tbsp = 8.5 g, tsp = 2.8 g: 2 tbsp + 1 tsp = 19.8 g, exact 2.3333x = 19.83 g, agree. Clove count from densities clove = 3 g (19.8/3 = 6.6, about 7). Board 5 of 7, cheapest Baker's $0.498/each.

Generic 'onion' = yellow onion = the onions commodity (red-onion-is-not-onions precedent kept). Countable printed first per house rule; densities medium each = 110 g, so 1 1/4 = 137.5 g. DRIFT NOTE: exact 2.3333x of the source's 55 g half-onion is 128.3 g, so quantizing up to the quarter costs +7.2% (macro-immaterial: +0.4 cal/serving). Board 7 of 7, cheapest Aldi $0.7967/lb.

Unqualified 'thyme' in a pantry-line slow-cooker recipe read as DRIED (no 'fresh'/'sprigs' cue anywhere on the page); the fresh form would be the form-flip here. densities tsp = 1 g; 2 1/4 tsp = 2.25 g, exact 2.3333 g, drift -3.6%. Board 5 of 7, cheapest Sam's $0.8776/oz.

ingredients.buy: 65 1/3 oz canned, with juices (about four and a half 14.5 oz cans)
ingredients.notes: The diced-tomatoes commodity's own include pattern 'diced\s+tomato(?:es)?' claims fire-roasted diced tomatoes by title and no exclude fires; flavor variant of the same canned product at the same price class, NOT a variety-pricing split like red onion (fire-roasted and plain sit side by side at ~$1/14.5 oz). Food DB uses the existing Diced Tomatoes row whose own note says 'fire-roasted equivalent'. Weight-anchored: 65 1/3 oz x 28.35 = 1852 g, exact 2.3333x. Board 7 of 7, cheapest Walmart $0.0529/oz.
Unmeasured to-taste seasoning line, marked optional by the extractor per house rule; zero grams booked, NOT enqueued.
